ocr.copied-body: Recognized text copied to the clipboard
ocr.empty-body: No text detected in the selection

search.opened-body: Opened the selection in Google Lens

missing.title: A required tool is missing
missing.tool: {tool} is not installed, so this action cannot run.

error.title: Screenshot overlay failed
error.no-data-dir: No writable data directory for the capture.
error.no-plugin-dir: The plugin directory could not be found, so capture.sh is missing.
error.no-report: The overlay did not report what happened.
error.no-capture: The captured image is gone; nothing to act on.
error.no-region: The overlay reported no region, so there is nothing to record.
error.not-started: That action could not be started; too many plugin commands are already running.
error.no-record-dir: Could not create the recording folder {dir}: {reason}
error.launch: The overlay could not be started: {reason}
error.copy-failed: The screenshot could not be copied to the clipboard.
error.edit-failed: The editor exited with an error; nothing was saved.
error.ocr-failed: tesseract ran, but the text could not be copied.
error.search-failed: The image could not be uploaded for search.

enable_cross.label: Enable Crosshair
enable_cross.description: Whether the overlay aims with a crosshair.

enable_windows_selection.label: Enable Window Detection
enable_windows_selection.description: Allow clicking a window to select its whole region, on compositors that can report window geometry.

screenshot_editor.label: Screenshot Annotation Tool
screenshot_editor.description: Command run on a right-click selection, as <tool> -f <in> -o <out>. Needs to be pre-installed; satty gets its own flag names.

keep_source_screenshot.label: Keep Source Screenshot
keep_source_screenshot.description: Keep the *_source.png the editor was given, next to the file it saved.

recording_save_path.label: Recording Save Folder
recording_save_path.description: Folder where screen recordings are written.

png_compression_level.label: PNG Compression Level
png_compression_level.description: PNG compression level (0=fastest, 9=smallest). Higher values take longer to write; lower values are faster and produce bigger files, which can make copying to the clipboard fail.

notifications_enabled.label: Enable Notifications
notifications_enabled.description: Show success notifications for screenshots, OCR and recording. Missing tools and failures are always reported.

recording_notifications.label: Recording Notifications
recording_notifications.description: Show notifications when a recording starts or stops.
